
AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE Item > SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#convertToText
        INSERT {
        ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
            id: saverSend
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            visible: controller && saverSend.likelyHasStroke()
            type: tools.type
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/checkmark_circle"

            property bool armed: false

            property var pendingRequest: null

            Timer {
                id: saverRequestWatchdog
                interval: 20000
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (saverSend.pendingRequest) {
                        saverSend.pendingRequest.abort();
                        saverSend.pendingRequest = null;
                    }
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: saverConvertWatchdog
                interval: 45000
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    if (saverSend.armed) {
                        saverSend.armed = false;
                        saverToast.show("Handwriting conversion timed out - check your Wi-Fi", false);
                    }
                }
            }

            function trackRequest(request) {
                saverSend.pendingRequest = request;
                saverRequestWatchdog.restart();
            }

            function finishRequest() {
                saverSend.pendingRequest = null;
                saverRequestWatchdog.stop();
            }

            readonly property string apiUrl: "https://api.saver-app.com/remarkable"
            readonly property string configPath: "file:///home/root/.config/saver-remarkable/config.toml"

            onClicked: {
                if (!controller) {
                    return;
                }
                saverSend.armed = true;
                saverConvertWatchdog.restart();
                saverToast.show("Converting handwriting...", true);
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(
                    controller.cloneSelectedItems(controller.currentLayer, saverSend.cloneScale()),
                    Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
            }

            function likelyHasStroke() {
                if (!controller) {
                    return false;
                }
                if (typeof controller.selectionContainsStroke !== "undefined") {
                    return controller.selectionContainsStroke;
                }
                return true;
            }

            function cloneScale() {
                if (typeof sceneView !== "undefined" && sceneView && sceneView.defaultScale > 0) {
                    return sceneView.defaultScale;
                }
                return 1;
            }

            Connections {
                target: Recognizer.selectionToolJob
                enabled: saverSend.armed

                function onStatusChanged() {
                    var job = Recognizer.selectionToolJob;
                    if (!job) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Done) {
                        saverSend.armed = false;
                        saverConvertWatchdog.stop();
                        saverSend.beginFlow(job.plainText);
                    } else if (job.status === RecognitionJob.Status.Error) {
                        saverSend.armed = false;
                        saverConvertWatchdog.stop();
                        saverToast.show(saverSend.errorMessage(job.error), false);
                        console.log("SAVER: conversion failed, error =", job.error);
                    }
                }
            }

            function errorMessage(code) {
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.AuthenticationError) {
                    return "Sign in to reMarkable to convert handwriting";
                }
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NetworkError) {
                    return "No connection - conversion needs Wi-Fi";
                }
                if (code === RecognitionJob.ConvertError.NoText) {
                    return "No handwriting recognised";
                }
                return "Handwriting conversion failed";
            }

            function valueFromConfig(body, key) {
                var quote = String.fromCharCode(34);
                var lines = (body || "").split("\n");
                for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                    var line = lines[i].trim();
                    if (line.indexOf(key) !== 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    var rest = line.substring(key.length).trim();
                    if (rest.charAt(0) !== "=") {
                        continue;
                    }
                    var value = rest.substring(1).trim();
                    if (value.length >= 2 && value.charAt(0) === quote
                        && value.charAt(value.length - 1) === quote) {
                        value = value.substring(1, value.length - 1);
                    }
                    return value;
                }
                return "";
            }

            function readConfig(onDone) {
                var cfg = new XMLHttpRequest();
                cfg.onreadystatechange = function () {
                    if (cfg.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var body = cfg.responseText;
                    var token = saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "device_token");
                    var confirmValue = saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "confirm_notebook_todos");
                    var defaultSpaceId = saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "notebook_default_space_id");
                    var defaultSpaceName = saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "notebook_default_space_name");
                    var defaultListId = defaultSpaceId.length > 0
                        ? saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "notebook_default_list_id") : "";
                    var defaultListName = defaultSpaceId.length > 0
                        ? saverSend.valueFromConfig(body, "notebook_default_list_name") : "";
                    onDone({
                        token: token,
                        confirmFirst: confirmValue !== "false",
                        defaultSpaceId: defaultSpaceId,
                        defaultSpaceName: defaultSpaceName,
                        defaultListId: defaultListId,
                        defaultListName: defaultListName,
                    });
                };
                cfg.open("GET", saverSend.configPath);
                cfg.send();
            }

            function beginFlow(text) {
                var trimmed = (text || "").trim();
                if (trimmed.length === 0) {
                    saverToast.show("No handwriting recognised", false);
                    return;
                }

                saverSend.readConfig(function (config) {
                    if (config.token.length === 0) {
                        saverToast.show("Link the tablet in the Saver app first", false);
                        console.log("SAVER: no device token in config");
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!config.confirmFirst) {
                        saverToast.show("Saving " + saverToast.shorten(trimmed) + "...", true);
                        saverSend.postTodo(config.token, trimmed,
                                           config.defaultSpaceId, config.defaultListId);
                        return;
                    }
                    saverToast.show("Loading your spaces...", true);
                    saverSend.fetchPickerOptions(config.token, trimmed,
                                                 config.defaultSpaceId, config.defaultListId);
                });
            }

            function fetchPickerOptions(token, text, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId) {
                var list = new XMLHttpRequest();
                list.onreadystatechange = function () {
                    if (list.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    saverSend.finishRequest();
                    if (list.status !== 200) {
                        console.log("SAVER: listPickerOptions ->", list.status, list.responseText);
                        saverToast.show("Could not load spaces - saving to your active space", true);
                        saverSend.postTodo(token, text, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId);
                        return;
                    }
                    var parsed = JSON.parse(list.responseText);
                    saverToast.show("", false);
                    saverConfirm.openFor(text, parsed.spaces || [], parsed.activeSpaceId || "",
                                         token, defaultSpaceId, defaultListId);
                };
                list.open("POST", saverSend.apiUrl);
                list.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
                list.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
                saverSend.trackRequest(list);
                list.send(JSON.stringify({ op: "listPickerOptions" }));
            }

            function postTodo(token, text, spaceId, parentId) {
                var body = { op: "createTodoFromNotebook", text: text };
                if (spaceId.length > 0) {
                    body.spaceId = spaceId;
                }
                if (parentId.length > 0) {
                    body.parentId = parentId;
                }

                var post = new XMLHttpRequest();
                post.onreadystatechange = function () {
                    if (post.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    saverSend.finishRequest();
                    console.log("SAVER: createTodoFromNotebook ->", post.status, post.responseText);
                    if (post.status === 200) {
                        saverToast.show("Added to Saver: " + saverToast.shorten(text), false);
                    } else if (post.status === 0) {
                        saverToast.show("Could not reach Saver - check Wi-Fi", false);
                    } else {
                        saverToast.show("Saver rejected it (" + post.status + ")", false);
                    }
                };
                post.open("POST", saverSend.apiUrl);
                post.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
                post.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
                saverSend.trackRequest(post);
                post.send(JSON.stringify(body));
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE Item
        LOCATE AFTER SelectionContextualMenu#tools
        INSERT {
        Rectangle {
            id: saverToast

            property string message: ""

            z: 200
            visible: saverToast.message.length > 0
            anchors.top: parent.top
            anchors.topMargin: 40
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 80, saverToastLabel.implicitWidth + 56)
            height: saverToastLabel.implicitHeight + 36
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 3
            radius: 8
            antialiasing: false

            Text {
                id: saverToastLabel
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: Math.min(implicitWidth, saverToast.parent.width - 136)
                text: saverToast.message
                font.pixelSize: 30
                color: "black"
                elide: Text.ElideRight
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            }

            Timer {
                id: saverToastTimer
                interval: 4000
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: saverToast.message = ""
            }

            function show(text, sticky) {
                saverToast.message = text;
                saverToastTimer.stop();
                if (text.length > 0 && !sticky) {
                    saverToastTimer.restart();
                }
            }

            function shorten(text) {
                var quote = String.fromCharCode(34);
                var flat = text.replace("\n", " ").trim();
                if (flat.length > 38) {
                    flat = flat.substring(0, 38) + "...";
                }
                return quote + flat + quote;
            }
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: saverConfirm

            property string token: ""
            property string text: ""
            property var spaces: []
            property string spaceId: ""
            property string spaceName: ""
            property string listId: ""
            property string listName: "No list"
            property string picking: ""

            z: 300
            visible: false
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            width: Math.min(parent.width - 160, 820)
            height: Math.min(parent.height - 160, 760)
            color: "white"
            border.color: "black"
            border.width: 3
            radius: 10
            antialiasing: false

            MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

            function findSpace(id) {
                for (var i = 0; i < saverConfirm.spaces.length; i++) {
                    if (saverConfirm.spaces[i].id === id) {
                        return saverConfirm.spaces[i];
                    }
                }
                return null;
            }

            function currentLists() {
                var space = saverConfirm.findSpace(saverConfirm.spaceId);
                return (space && space.lists) ? space.lists : [];
            }

            function openFor(initialText, spaceList, activeSpaceId, authToken,
                             defaultSpaceId, defaultListId) {
                saverConfirm.token = authToken;
                saverConfirm.text = initialText;
                saverConfirm.spaces = spaceList;
                saverConfirm.picking = "";

                var preferredId = defaultSpaceId.length > 0 ? defaultSpaceId : activeSpaceId;
                var chosen = saverConfirm.findSpace(preferredId) || spaceList[0] || null;
                saverConfirm.spaceId = chosen ? chosen.id : "";
                saverConfirm.spaceName = chosen ? chosen.name : "No space available";

                saverConfirm.listId = "";
                saverConfirm.listName = "No list";
                if (chosen && chosen.id === defaultSpaceId && defaultListId.length > 0) {
                    var lists = chosen.lists || [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < lists.length; i++) {
                        if (lists[i].id === defaultListId) {
                            saverConfirm.listId = lists[i].id;
                            saverConfirm.listName = lists[i].title;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                confirmTextEdit.text = initialText;
                saverConfirm.visible = true;
            }

            function selectSpace(id, name) {
                saverConfirm.spaceId = id;
                saverConfirm.spaceName = name;
                saverConfirm.listId = "";
                saverConfirm.listName = "No list";
                saverConfirm.picking = "";
            }

            function selectList(id, name) {
                saverConfirm.listId = id;
                saverConfirm.listName = name;
                saverConfirm.picking = "";
            }

            function cancel() {
                saverConfirm.visible = false;
                saverToast.show("Discarded", false);
            }

            function submit() {
                var finalText = confirmTextEdit.text.trim();
                if (finalText.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                saverConfirm.visible = false;
                saverToast.show("Saving " + saverToast.shorten(finalText) + "...", true);
                saverSend.postTodo(saverConfirm.token, finalText,
                                   saverConfirm.spaceId, saverConfirm.listId);
            }

            Column {
                anchors.left: parent.left
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.margins: 32
                spacing: 20
                visible: saverConfirm.picking.length === 0

                Text {
                    text: "Save to Saver"
                    font.pixelSize: 34
                    font.bold: true
                    color: "black"
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 180
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 6

                    Flickable {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 14
                        clip: true
                        contentWidth: width
                        contentHeight: confirmTextEdit.implicitHeight

                        TextEdit {
                            id: confirmTextEdit
                            width: parent.width
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "black"
                            wrapMode: TextEdit.Wrap
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    spacing: 16

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6

                        Text {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: 12
                            text: "Space: " + saverConfirm.spaceName
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "black"
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "space"
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: 64
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 6
                        opacity: saverConfirm.spaceId.length > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.4

                        Text {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: 12
                            text: "List: " + saverConfirm.listName
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "black"
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            enabled: saverConfirm.spaceId.length > 0
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = "list"
                        }
                    }
                }

                Row {
                    width: parent.width
                    spacing: 16
                    height: 76

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: parent.height
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 2
                        radius: 8

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Cancel"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.cancel()
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: (parent.width - 16) / 2
                        height: parent.height
                        color: "white"
                        border.color: "black"
                        border.width: 3
                        radius: 8
                        opacity: confirmTextEdit.text.trim().length > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.35

                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Save"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            font.bold: true
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            enabled: confirmTextEdit.text.trim().length > 0
                            onClicked: saverConfirm.submit()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 24
                spacing: 16
                visible: saverConfirm.picking.length > 0

                Text {
                    text: saverConfirm.picking === "space" ? "Choose a space" : "Choose a list"
                    font.pixelSize: 30
                    font.bold: true
                    color: "black"
                }

                ListView {
                    id: pickerList
                    width: parent.width
                    height: parent.height - 130
                    clip: true
                    model: {
                        if (saverConfirm.picking === "space") {
                            return saverConfirm.spaces;
                        }
                        if (saverConfirm.picking === "list") {
                            var options = [{ id: "", title: "No list" }];
                            return options.concat(saverConfirm.currentLists());
                        }
                        return [];
                    }

                    delegate: Rectangle {
                        width: pickerList.width
                        height: 72
                        color: "white"

                        Text {
                            anchors.left: parent.left
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            anchors.leftMargin: 8
                            text: saverConfirm.picking === "space" ? modelData.name : modelData.title
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            color: "black"
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            width: parent.width
                            height: 1
                            color: "#d0d0d0"
                        }

                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: {
                                if (saverConfirm.picking === "space") {
                                    saverConfirm.selectSpace(modelData.id, modelData.name);
                                } else {
                                    saverConfirm.selectList(modelData.id, modelData.title);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 76
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Back"
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: saverConfirm.picking = ""
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/HwcSelection.qml
    TRAVERSE Item > HwcNotificationBar#handwritingBar
        REPLACE onFinishedChanged WITH {
        onFinishedChanged: {
            if (!finished) {
                return;
            }
            if (!root.visible) {
                return;
            }
            Clipboard.text = recognitionJob.formattedTextToClipboardText();
            if (Clipboard.hasText) {
                conversionFinished();
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
